objective: Create an evidence-backed PMO baseline for the P1/P2/P3 program without converting templates or scripted fixtures into delivery evidence.
acceptance: all twelve PMO tasks map to maintained repository artifacts
the plan exposes phase gates dependencies and a dated baseline
every risk has an owner trigger mitigation contingency review date and evidence reference
status and metrics preserve unknown blocked and not-executed states
the baseline is linked from the documentation navigation and has deterministic tests
stop_conditions: a physical result external participant record or human decision would need to be inferred
an interface safety or release setting change is required
the plan would label a template or scripted fixture as release evidence
